description: This PHP class defines the ProjectActivityModel which represents a data model for project activities within the OrangeHRM Time plugin API. It implements serialization and normalization functionalities and maps to the ProjectActivity entity, exposing 'id', 'name', and 'deleted' properties.

classes.name: ProjectActivityModel
classes.description: A data model class for project activities in the OrangeHRM Time plugin API, providing serialization and normalization for ProjectActivity entities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the ProjectActivityModel using a ProjectActivity entity, configuring filters and attribute mappings.
